title: Sequencing: investment pitches
bodyMd:
Five teams deliver pitches in five successive positions, each team once.

Positions are numbered 1 to 5 in order. The items are Cedar, Flint, Harbour, Juniper, Quartz.

- Exactly 2 other items must occur between Cedar and Harbour.
- Quartz must be immediately followed by Flint.
- Juniper must not be in position 3.
